findings.title: Valid gzip/Brotli HTTP shards are rejected by the exact Content-Length check
findings.scope: Opt-in lazy coefficient delivery through an HTTP server that includes Content-Encoding and the compressed Content-Length. Default 13 models are unaffected.

Error: Moon asset exceeds declared transfer budget or differs from exact shard length

findings.impact: Native fetch decodes the body while retaining the compressed Content-Length header. Line 168 compares that wire length with entry.bytes (decoded JSON length), rejecting legitimate compressed shards before their verified decoded bytes can be admitted. The existing uncompressed local HTTP evidence does not cover this delivery path.
findings.recommendation: Apply exact advertised-length equality only when the representation is unencoded. For encoded responses, keep appropriate advertised transfer bounds and retain the existing streamed decoded-size cap, exact final decoded length, SHA-256, semantic certificate and cleanup checks. Add the compressed native HTTP regression; do not increase any numerical or byte caps.

passBoundaries.contract: Numerical and certificate caps remain fixed
passBoundaries.details: Every lazy manifest/model retains min(500 km, 0.001 * minimum alias aKm) and 10 m/s. All shipped aggregate/oracle percentile sets are ordered, nonnegative and within those limits. Runtime requires exact ordered alias IDs, seven oracle samples per alias and finite nonnegative ordered p50/p95/p99/max values before caching. Rehashed malformed-certificate regressions exercise semantics.

passBoundaries.contract: Failure cleanup, shard concurrency, retry and deadlines
passBoundaries.details: Reviewed acquired-response failure paths abort transport, await reader/body cancellation before shard permit transfer, release locks/timers and preserve original errors. One 30-second default deadline covers headers and all chunks (configurable 1..120000 ms); shard concurrency is bounded 1..8, default 4. A custom fetch that ignores abort may resolve after the deadline; its late body is cancelled asynchronously, so an absolute physical-transfer bound is not certified for such noncompliant transports. A cancellation that never settles after an acquired response retains its slot.

passBoundaries.details: JUnit records 460 passed, zero failures/errors/skips, including test_clean_checkout_offline_rebuild_of_all_410_shards. Read the isolated-copy runner: no candidate cache or node_modules prerequisite, socket/URL acquisition blocked, --offline --check repeats all source fits and compares all shards/index byte-for-byte. Scope is Python 3.12.13/NumPy 2.5.2 pinned stack; not a cross-platform bitwise guarantee. Git preservation remains MOON-I2.

passBoundaries.details: Daphnis remains the explicitly dated legacy SAT393 Cassini fit (kernel release 2016-10-11; observations through 2016-07-16), with two native jumps, explicit right-hand semantics and discontinuity qualification; no relaxed accuracy cap. S2023_S38 remains geometric Cartesian sat455_merged_DE440, including a positive instantaneous two-body-energy probe without a permanent-escape claim. Native summary checks 115 requests but reports zero original envelopes in its assigned cache; separate freshly recorded source-audit.json finds and rehashes all 115 originals in the prepared-worktree cache. This distinction resolves the apparent envelope discrepancy. The same audit covers 1370 lazy envelopes and lossless retained rows; audit script read, large audit not rerun. Numerical-source identity does not establish original HTTP wire authenticity or observational uncertainty.

682 unit tests and 460 Python/native tests pass in recorded evidence. Existing production build/local nested-path HTTP evidence covers uncompressed assets only. Independent bounded native HTTP probe passes identity delivery and fails valid gzip/br delivery (MOON-I1). Broad suites were not rerun.
